messages.subject: Instructions to advise — Okafor v Ashbourne Healthcare Group (2204417/2025)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Clerks,

We should be grateful for Ms Vance's view on merits and a realistic settlement range in this whistleblowing-dismissal matter. In short: genuine redundancy situation and process, but an unhelpful timeline and the selection scoring done by the manager who received the protected disclosures. Papers (ET1, ET3, redundancy bundle, 2024 disclosures file, claimant's schedule of loss) to follow by secure link.

A short written advice and, if convenient, a 30-minute con with Mr Pryce next week would be ideal.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Instructions to advise — Okafor v Ashbourne Healthcare Group (2204417/2025)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Harriet is happy to advise. Her provisional view, subject to the papers, is that the ordinary unfair dismissal claim is defensible but the s.103A risk is real and the absence of an independent scorer is the principal weakness. She would put the realistic settlement zone in the region of £110k–£130k and recommends a commercial resolution. She can do a con on Tuesday 22 April at 4pm.

Best,
Clerks, Eldon Chambers
